caption:
Google is retiring the built-in chat button on Business Profiles.

WhatsApp and SMS now handle messages sent straight from Maps and Search.

More entry points for leads sounds like a win, until you remember most service businesses take hours, not minutes, to answer a new lead. Every channel you turn on is one more place a message can sit unread.

Route every channel, call, text, GBP message, into one inbox with automatic text-back. Speed shouldn't depend on which button a customer tapped.

See it running on your own leads. 14 days free.

rationale: Interprets a genuinely current, unclaimed GBP messaging shift (Chat retiring for WhatsApp/SMS) through the account's speed-to-lead thesis, in the reel format that wins cold-audience reach for news.
